This documentary was made just previous to the post war invasion of the European glass box into the United States (think Mies van der Rohe's arrival in Chicago). Its thesis lends itself more to the American ideal in the vein of mixed-use living (and zoning) than in the emergence of the massive welfare blocks of the 1950s and 60s. It is refreshing that there is very little dialogue, it is more of a visual experience.
